question: In which of the following years, did Subhas Chandra Bose refer to Mahatma Gandhi as the “Father of the Nation”?
solution:
The correct answer is **1944.**

__
 
• Subhash Chandra Bose was the first person to address 'Mahatma Gandhi as the Father of the Nation'.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• On **July 6, 1944, Subhash Chandra Bose** said in a telecast of** Azad Hind Radio** to Mahatma Gandhi that **“the last war of independence of India has begun.**
 
• We want blessings of you in this holy war of liberation of the Father of the Nation.” And wish you all the best.
